snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.2 - The Content Update!
snippet.description:
Chris's Classroom has taken a huge step and with that comes a LOT of new content!

↓↓↓ Update V1.2 Log ↓↓↓

- Finished Thomas's AI
- Added Fan[1] item
- Added Big Bad Mac[2] structure
- Expanded map
- Added more collectible items
- Added Theodore[3]
- Added Keith[4]
- Added Fin[5]
- Added Ethan[6]
- Added 2 new interactable NPCs[7]
- Added Skull Emoji item[8]
- Added voicelines for Chris
- Finished Classic Mode
- Added Super Hard Mode
- Updated Detention UI
- Added an easter egg (more to come!)
- Added more vending machines to the Cafeteria
- Added a new Win screen

[1] The Fan, when used, doubles the player's speed for 10 seconds
[2] The Big Bad Mac plays a horrible noise for 20 seconds when user with Chris's ID Card. It plays a loud, annoying sound which stuns all characters for the duration.
[3] Theodore has similar mechanics to Gotta Sweep. After 30 seconds upon collecting the 2nd stress toy, Theodore will become active, playing a signature voiceline. Theodore will push the player upon collision.
[4] Keith has similar mechanics to It's A Bully. Upon collecting the 2nd stress toy, Keith will become active. When approached by the player, he will demand an item. If the player touches him with an item, he will take the item and relocate somewhere else. If the player does not give him an item within one minute, Keith will relocate somewhere else.
[5] Fin has similar mechanics to Playtime. Upon collecting the 2nd stress toy, Fin will become active and play one of three voicelines. If Fin spots the player, he will challenge them to catch him, and his AI will now change to actively avoid the player. If the player catches Fin, he will congratulate them by refilling their stamina, and then becoming inactive for one minute, before restarting the cycle.
[6] Ethan has similar mechanics to First Prize. Upon collecting the 2nd stress toy, Ethan will become active and play one of five voicelines. When seeing the player, Ethan will gradually speed up and move towards the player to huf them. While in a hug, Ethan and the player cannot move for five seconds, but during the hug, the player's stamina regen is multiplied by four until released.
[7] The two NPCs can be found throughout the map, and will give tips for certain things, like items or characters.
[8] The Skull Emoji, when used, grants 2 minutes of immunity from Theodore.

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in the game are created by me!
